config.hoesarescythes.title: Hoes Are Scythes
config.hoesarescythes.server_note: These settings apply to singleplayer and worlds you host. On a multiplayer server, the server's own config file is used.
config.hoesarescythes.vanilla_hoe.toolti: Clearing radius in blocks (0–16). 0 turns this hoe off.
config.hoesarescythes.other_hoes.tooltip:
Modded hoes or #tags, one per line, then the radius (0–16).
e.g. othermod:steel_hoe = 3 or #c:hoes = 3
A specific item always wins over a #tag.
config.hoesarescythes.extra_blocks.toolt:
Blocks or #tags a hoe should also clear.
e.g. minecraft:fern or #minecraft:flowers
config.hoesarescythes.error.vanilla_hoe: Set vanilla hoes in their own field above
config.hoesarescythes.error.radius: Radius must be a whole number from 0 to 16
